## Description

Clusters assets, optimizes within clusters, then optimizes across cluster portfolios to reduce dimensionality and covariance instability.

## Where it may fit

Large correlated asset universes where direct mean-variance optimization is unstable.

## Vehicles

Multi-asset hedge funds, equity portfolios and systematic allocation.

## Required data

Returns, covariance/correlation estimates, clustering choices, expected returns if used, constraints and rebalance schedule.

## Caveats

Optimization layers can amplify estimation error; fit clusters only on training data and test stability over time.
